temporal_status: Retrospective documentary reconciliation after catalogue/results; no preregistration or claim of bibliographic causality.

research_tracks.applied_core: Empirical BTC/cryptocurrency dispersion forecasting with verified DL predictor. Variance/std/RV/IV/historical/conditional proxies in separate strata; 2019–2026, foundational sources contextual.
research_tracks.mechanism_context: Original architectures and transferable methods from other domains are separate from applied crypto efficacy. A population exclusion from applied core does not exclude a source from mechanism context.

screening_rules.population: BTC or cryptocurrency; ambiguity retained for further source review.
screening_rules.outcome: Actual dispersion prediction target; price, log-return, direction and trading alone are distinct outcomes. Mentioning a volatile market does not establish volatility as outcome.
screening_rules.neural: Deep >=2 hidden transformation layers or LSTM/GRU/CNN/attention/SSM; hybrid verified. Econometric-only or single-layer ANN not sufficient.
screening_rules.quality: Missing seeds, HPO equality or code are quality limits, not automatic narrative exclusion.
screening_rules.evidence: Title-only exclusions must rely on positive evidence of incompatible population/outcome/source type. Silence about DL or abstract absence is not evidence of no DL. Ambiguous records retained.
screening_rules.eligibility: Abstract screening never substitutes report/fulltext eligibility. Prior verified reviews are reused by exact study identity.

review_method.adjudicators: AI-assisted, coordinated review; no independent human double review or kappa claim.
review_method.triage: Broad lexical queue for scheduling only; never represented as individual semantic reading.
review_method.read_evidence: Per-group title-only vs full-abstract-read vs primary-report-reviewed; exact abstract hash where read.

identity_rules: Fallback exact normalized title AND mandatory matching year AND unique candidate AND no DOI conflict.
No fuzzy merging, no new group identities, no abstract-count-to-inclusion conversion.
publication_boundary: Publish bibliographic facts, hashes, locators and brief original adjudications; keep exports, full abstracts, local attachment paths and private reading notes outside public repository.
historical_limits: Missing 374 Scopus occurrences remain a search coverage deviation, never scientific exclusions.
Query-to-WoS-batch/range mapping unverified where original history did not establish it.
Neither restored abstracts nor updated citation snapshots retrospectively change scientific selection/test chronology.
prohibition: Do not label9559records as individual AI reading using deterministic rules.
